facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's digital health architecture guide (April 2023) states that its framework is aligned with the Uganda e-Government Interoperability Framework (NITA-U, 2021) and the e-Government Interoperability Reference Architecture (GoU, 2021).

note: The guide is a health-sector framework (other); the national e-GIF fact is its reference to NITA-U's 2021 framework.
